args.new:
theorem double_eq (n : Nat) : double n = 2 * n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp [double] at *
    rw [ih]
    simp only [Nat.mul_succ, add_assoc]
    rfl
